reviews.text: Not what it seems…. If you have the Go City New York explorer pass please be aware at Madison Square Garden is usually sold out so when you show up, you can’t get tickets for the same day and you’re only allowed to get tickets for the same day. Madison Square Garden sells its own tickets and it seems like whatever leftover tickets for that day can be allocated to Go City past users. This is not stated in the Go City program. It seems like it’s this way for a few other attractions as well so I would highly suggest just paying out-of-pocket at each attraction rather than buying a Go City pass.
Not Worth It. It doesn't deliver value for the money. Dealing with 3rd parties outside of the app is an obnoxious chore.

Good option. Some attractions are cheaper this way. Beware that the passes might not allow you to get to full activities in dome places like the spyscape, nor get to the pedestal
Or crown of the statue of liberty. But still a good option.
Rip off. Way too much work
Michigan visitor. This is the way to go if you want to do more than one excursion. The only downside is that the times overlap so it's hard to enjoy more of the city.

Good for showing your pass only. The option to plan your trip is awful. You can’t move stuff around and it’s very clunky. This would be such a great app if you could actually easily do that. Other than that it’s just good for showing your pass.

Wish I Could Give Go City Negative Stars. Please be prepared to miss out on most of the attractions that are supposedly included and spend more in the process. Many of the attractions were already unavailable after we purchased our Go City pass, which you cannot know until after you buy this pass. The attractions that were available were listed as included in the app, however this is misleading because they have a tier system which limits what type of attractions you can visit and these are not outlined in the app. When we accidentally booked two attractions from the same tier, there was no indication within the app we could not attend both. Customer service was unfriendly and unhelpful in resolving this. I would recommend pre-booking tickets directly through the attraction you would like to see instead of using this clunky app that will most likely cost you more instead of saving as advertised.

Buggy, poorly designed, implemented and supported product. We used this for Singapore. Seems good on paper but once you pay them things don’t work smoothly. In short it is better to just pay at each attraction you visit. Here’s the longer version 

1. After you pay, it takes 4 hours to even get your pass by email. 
2. The pass only works on each attraction once. If you end up really wanting to see it again you can’t. But if you book directly with the attractions you have full control. 
3. The night safari instructions on the website and email don’t match and are very confusing. Trying to get support is a nightmare due to AI chatbots blocking you.
4. After getting to the night safari line the process to redeem tickets is very arduous and frustrating, likely due to a poorly designed website/ux. It is far easier to just buy the tickets online from the zoo. 

I gave it a 2 because I did manage to see all the attractions I wanted to so I’m assuming I saved a little money. But it wasn’t worth the hassle.


Updated rating to one because every attraction we went to required us to go to a completely different place get our ticket validated, and then go back to the queue. It was a huge waste of time and very confusing.

Unbelievably disappointed. U have to get he head out app, to get the go city app to book with another site… all places telling u diff things to book, cancel,
Etc…too late to do what our 1st choice was… will never use again

Wasted hundreds. I was planning a trip to San Diego. I did an entire week of researching making sure this wasn’t a scam and choosing what we wanted to do. Decided to choose the one that had the aquarium, uss midway, San Diego zoo and San Diego zoo safari. Bought a 3 day pass for just under $500. We did the midway and aquarium yesterday. Drove 45 min this morning to do the safari today and zoo tomorrow. Tickets wouldn’t scan so they sent us to the help area. Turns out from when I bought the pass last month to now they changed it and the zoo and aquarium are no longer available with the pass I bought and they won’t honor it. So I literally paid almost $500 to do 2 things that wouldn’t have even costed us $100 for our small party of 3. Absolutely livid. This is literally our first vacation in 20 years and we were devastated because now we can’t afford the zoo or safari park and it was the entire reason we chose this area. Deleting this app and will never purchase again. Words cannot even express how upset we are with this whole program.

Can lag on sending tickets. I purchased a GoCity pass for Singapore that included Universal Studios. When I tried to redeem one of four Universal Studios tickets, there was an over two hour delay in the ticket being sent. On my end, it seemed that it just didn’t work. The end result was that GoCity
Customer support told me to purchase my ticket with my own money and they assured me that they would refund me later. However, it took one and a half months of back-and-forth with customer service before the refund was approved. I think this could be a great deal when it works, but this whole experience has completely soured me on ever using this pass or recommending it to anyone.
So easy to use. So easy to use. All of the locations knew what it was it was accepted with out a problem .

Overpriced. No way you can get your money’s worth out what is being charged. Simple math. I was charged $100 USD for a one day pass. Each museum charges $15 to enter. You can’t possibly see 4 a day particularly when open from 10 to5. Also thought I was getting a 5 day pass. Only find out it was only for 1. The money back guarantee is out after the first day. After that you are out of luck.

Not worth it. Bought the pass for my Dublin trip, most things you can’t book until a few days in advance and personally I would rather have everything booked prior to travel. Their customer service is trash. Wouldn’t recommend
Great opportunities!. We really enjoyed our activities!

Not worth it.. The guided tour passes are outsourced to other companies and there is little to no flexibly once go city hands off to them. May be worth it during busy seasons but don’t expect alot of support or flexibility from go city if anything comes up or your plans change.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️. I used the Go City app for the first time and really loved it. What I appreciated most was how easy it was to control and customize my itinerary without stressing over planning. Everything was organized in one place, and I could decide what to do and when without feeling rushed or locked into a schedule. It made sightseeing feel simple and flexible, which took a lot of pressure off the trip. I’d definitely use it again.

Plan to spend the day and pack a lunch. We arrived at 10am and left around 4:30. You would be pressed to try and get thru in less time. You are allowed to bring in your own food and eat in the designated areas which is a great budget option!
Excellent Ride. Alvina drove that bus better then my husband who’s a bus driver himself. Great personality and excellent customer service!!!

Help desk actually helped!. My family of 13 got passes in San Diego this last summer. The website and what is included and everything in the different passes can be a confusing and misleading. So read carefully. It ended up being a possible waste of almost the entire purchase, and with that many passes, a huge chunk of money! (Thousands!) I spoke with different representatives over two days of our vacation, which is not ideal when you are trying to vacation. Not one really cared about the situation or really tried to understand. They basically had the attitude of “too bad you didn’t understand the confusing website”. Until I was able to talk to ANMOL who was a supervisor that actually took the time to listen and understand and try to help. We found a middle ground that worked out for city pass and for my family. Absolutely wonderful customer service from ANMOL. This vacation was back on June 6-15, 2025. But life is busy and I’m taking the time to write this now finally, because great customer service these days is extremely rare, and I hope this gets back to him in some way. And if any of you need help with your go city pass, I hope you can reach ANMOL.
Must have!!!!. This is an amazing app, makes your experience even better
少し分かりにくい. アクティベートの仕方が書かれていなくて苦労しました。長く滞在する人にはリーズナブルで良く、楽しめると思います。

extremely disappointed, don’t use it. The city pass it’s too expensive and it doesn’t work on the auto attraction. You cannot enter anywhere. And they’re asking you for more money absolutely ridiculous. not worth it at all

When in Dublin …. Great inter-active app for tourists! IF ONLY it showed “I am here” 
We enjoyed the tours, the drivers are entertainment and full of information
Don’t Go City Pass. Waste of money and time. No one honors the pass constantly get rejected at the door. Have to go to another location to get a different ticket.
Princess Di. Best way to travel

City sightseeing bus Hop On Hop Off. I am very upset! This morning a bus did not come to stop number 12 until 10:45. This wasted a lot of the morning. 
Right now my husband and I have been waiting for over an hour for one of your Hop On Hop Off busses in Old Town stop 2 it's 3:42. We have wasted so much time 
The other Red Bus comes all the time. 
I want a refund!

Worthless. I purchased 2 day Go city pass for my full family and it was worthless, it does not cover key attractions and also pass gets expires before time, when reached out to support team they were not able to help to activate it. The experience was very frustrating as we travelled long to cover the attraction which was in our pass but before time it got expired and no support from customer service. Overall poor experience. Waste of money as attractions included are far from each other so any ways you won’t be able to cover it

Good. The GoCity pass saved me money based on the attractions given. The problems I have encountered with the pass are that the description is not correct on some of the attractions. For example, the Rouge show says 9pm on Mondays and they did not have that performance available on Mondays. The Las Vegas Bar Crawl says that you get a drink at the bar stops but it was only 1/2 price drinks which is okay but I thought I was getting a drink with the pass. The Hop on Hop off bus was extremely hot during the day so I don’t recommend anyone doing that. It would be better if it was night. Overall it was good and typically easy to show the pass and get into the attractions.

Total disappointment. On our third day my son woke up sick, so I reached out to CityGo support for help. 

The automated system was no help at all, so I asked for a human, when finally connected with a human …after outer scheduled appt time. 
I was told we were marked as a no show! While I was on with this support person for 40 mins, 30 mins of that that could have used to assist me in letting the vendor know we had complications to our appt?instead I was told we were marked as a “No Show”! 

Very insulting and the customer service associate showed no empathy nor did they have an understanding of the situation and the irony of my reaching out to inform CityGo of our appt issue only to be told that we were no shows! How are you a no show when you reach out for help with the scheduled appt?!?!…?

Besides that terrible experience all the other Cx supporters people I contacted were incredibly helpful,and many of the sights amd experiences were enjoyable!

I think we have been given all the help we need at the moment… I might suggest not using CityGo, and just buy A la cart, via Groupon or some other discount offers.

As you can see,At the moment, I am quite frustrated with city go because I reached out for help via the Support link seeking help this morning before an appointment scheduled at the Sears tower SkyDeck. 

Only to be told that we were marked as a no-show ...during our 40 minchat/text/conversation which was why I was calling to ask for help about our inability to make the appointment! 

However the rescheduled boating experience was handled awesomely by the attendant we just spoke with!

London Pass is user UN friendly.. I tried to use GoCity to make a reservation. I gave it my dates of travel. Those dates were not available in the reservation page. I made a reservation in order to edit it, but there was no warning that I was making a reservation for 5 minutes in the future (time zone difference). Now my pass has been used and London Pass will not cancel my reservation.
Easy. The app can do everything you will need. Just need a smart phone and battery!. Best deal for two people three days and five choices
Amazing!!!. The best for my buck and amazing in Singapore!!

Don’t waste your money. Good luck if you choose to use this app. You barely save any money. You have to hit 4 attractions a day and if you don’t. Tough luck. Just pay at the sites and spend the extra 30 pounds. The trip planner doesn’t include every site so don’t bank on that either. This app also doesn’t include time sites are open so make sure you account for that before hand. Again, just get the tickets at the site.
More pricy. It was more pricy than buying individual tickets and barely any lines to buy tickets either. Save your $ it was 15% more after 20% discount

Waste of Money. So the pass does indicate if an exhibit is busy you may be asked to wait… it does not tell you that you can be denied entrance. We went to Westminster Abbey only to find City Pass holders were not permitted entrance until 1 pm, however, we had a walking tour (also part of the pass) booked but that tour required a reservation. The Abbey was closed the day before and the day after but our passes were only good for three days. This happened at a second exhibit as well. We ended up buying tickets AGAIN to gain entrance to two exhibits covered by the pass. Places can get extremely busy and even if they suggest one hour for a visit, expect it to be much longer due to long lines and crowds inside. I do not recommend buying the pass unless you’re doing things that allow you to book and guarantee a spot.

App is smooth, Pass is handy, but…. For the London pass at least, you’d really have to hit the gas to make a one day pass cost effective. Do a quick calculation before buying. There are a lot of excursions “included” with the pass, but several are already free, so keep that in mind as well. For 2-3 days, it can totally be worth it. Plus, it makes it easier than finding your tickets for each individual place.

I really dislike that the days go by Calendar days and not 24 hour periods. I purchased the London Pass, and unfortunate events affected my day until the evening where I had a reservation at the Shard. I forgot about the calendar day rule, so scanning in there started my two day pass. A couple hours later, my day 1 had ended after one excursion. Is there a reason it’s not 24 hours?

THE BEST WAY TO TRAVEL!. If I can give 6 stars! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This is hands down the best way to travel and check out the city you are traveling! And may I add the best way to SAVE money! The app is so easy to use as gives you all the necessary steps and what to expect. All the attractions listed has all the info that you need. It also can create an itinerary for you. Make the most of your vacation with GoCity! I can’t wait for our next trip. 

For skeptics…this is absolutely legit. My whole family loved it. I have seen some bad reviews due to attractions not open or changes schedule..etc. I get it, but you also have to double check the locations. They do not own those properties! If the attraction is closed it’s not GoCity pass fault lol. Also, you have to check your attraction website to see their latest schedules. To make sure you can make the most. First make sure you can make it to the attraction. Check their website first and give them a call. I call and contact all the attraction to make sure. Also a lot of shows will require you show up early. So you have to show up early. City pass gives you the deals. 

Here’s an example: We were literally rushing to get to the show at least 30mins before the times as stated in the app. This day there were only 7pm and 9pm show. We were trying to get to the 9pm. On the way..while on the car - I checked their website again..this is around 8:12pm. I checked their schedule
and I am glad I did. The show cancelled the 9pm show. And Go city has the correct date and time on the app. BUT!!!! just like this scenario…I will not blame Go City for this..they don’t own the show!!! They just give you opportunity to see it. Your job is to also do your homework. This app is AMAZING! But you should also take the extra effort to contact and check each location. I did that and we were able to utilize everything we needed. As a result! My family had the best time and I couldn’t ask for more. I worked too! I was calling and emailing and always checking before our next destination. This is the best way to use it. 

We used it for Vegas for 2 days all inclusive for a party of 4. I have 2 teenagers and this is their first time visiting Vegas. I wanted my family to have the full experience and Go City made it all possible with out breaking the bank. We visited so many places in two days!! Absolutely worth every penny. We had a blast! Thank you go City!!!

Limited access pass. So far I do not recommend this app! I purchased 2 2 day passes for an upcoming trip to France. For the first two sites this pass is only good for a limited access pass. At Versailles it did not include everything in the passport ticket…and then at the Eiffel Tower it paid for a walking tour up the steps, not a ticket for the elevator to the top. My suggestion would be to throughly research what you are wanting to do at each site verses what this app pays for. It is not all inclusive.
So annoying!. The app randomly erased our passes for my family of 8! Very stressful!

Great Value. I was a little skeptical that booking activities would be easy, but I was pleasantly surprised how easy it was to book events. Highly recommend giving this app a chance. I easily saved $500 over the span of just two days.
I love this pass!. I used this pass for a Spring Break trip to San Antonio! Simple to use. Show the pass on your phone, they scan, and you go! Well worth the money!

Don’t buy it. We bought it for the trip to London, because I saw a lot of advertisement and we thought it could be useful as it seems like a free pass to all attractions. But apparently not!
1. It is not flexible! Some attractions require you reserve a time slot, but it is not very clear to the customer that there is a 15mins amendment window. If you miss it, it is considered as a no show, and you cannot use it on the next day. And they do nothing to help you. The customer service is also not very efficient. It took us 1.5 hrs to communicate with them, and to get a “no”. 
 
2. You need to carefully plan your trip, otherwise, it will not worth it.
For our trip at London, many attractions take much longer time than we expected. So it is a quite stretch to visit all included attractions to get it worth it. 

My recommendation: unless you are very sure you can make it worth it, don’t bother to buy it.

Did not receive what I paid for. We were supposed to receive two days on the San Diego trolley and only received one. We called for assistance and did not receive the help we needed. I will never buy a go city pass again.
No Mexico City, in spite of search. This app shd not show up in search results for cities that it doesn’t have, like Mexico City. Don’t waste my time.

Awesome Travel Package. My family and I have used Go City deals since over ten years ago, and we are always happy with the packages, which we could save money and the travel sites are always the best places.

Always fantastic!. I have been utilizing the GoCity pass for years, both Explorer & All Inclusive passes. They are both fantastic & I plan so many trips around GoCity destinations! 

They are especially great if you are not familiar with the city & you need some activities that you may or may not be familiar with.

Does not do well with mistakes.. I accidentally had an event set for a few months earlier than my trip. And they do not know how to handle that properly. I was told I’d be able to get my trip rescheduled but apparently not.

Good option. Go city is an amazing option for exploring any city. It’s easy to use. The only negative that I see is that yo have to filter carefully to make sure the attraction you want will be included on your pass. Not sure it was a glitch but gives us the impression that Kennedy Space Center was included in explorer pass, when is not. We have a great time on the other attractions chosen. Definitely will purchase again.

Big Scam. My girlfriend and I took a trip to New York and wanted to save some money through this pass we did the all day pass which gives you unlimited access to attractions for one calendar date we bought them 10 in the morning were able to do one attraction and had a reservation later in the day for the Empire State Building we were busy and didn’t look at our phones and they cancelled our pass at 6pm we were not able to go up to the Empire State Building. We requested a refund for our 300$ we spent and they said the best they could do is 10% they said it was due to a glitch but still would not refund me and there costumer support is horrible being on hold for hours keep on saying give 48 hours to get back to you and they never call. They are scammers and this is a joke.

Worst experience. I purchased and attempted to book yours and received number of error messages from the tour company. Even though the site says to contact for booking they refuse to help online or over the phone. I called go city they sent me to the tour company and now they cancelled one of the few I was able to book.

Terrible Customer Representative. I wasted 40 minutes trying to resolve a single reservation issue with an agent. The agent continuously offered incorrect excuses, such as claiming the slot was full, even though I hadn’t reached that step yet. Each time I provided evidence disproving their claims, the agent would quickly switch to another excuse, presenting it with unwavering confidence and then repeating it. Finally, after dragging the conversation out, the agent suggested ending it, citing its length. This experience was frustrating and unprofessional.
Doesn’t work!!. If you want to spend your time on an automated chat trying to get the pass you purchased and never used to work, buy this one. Otherwise, move on.

Costs more than direct ticket purchases. Buy your tickets direct instead of this city card. 
I bought a Sydney City pass for my family of 5 for AUD600. The cost of tickets for the 3 attractions was less than AUD550. I’m still waiting to see if they’ll refund the difference.

Cancelación antes de tiempo. Reserve un pase todo incluido y lo active el viernes a las 10 am y me lo cancelaron el domingo a las 4 pm lo cual solo habían concurrido 54 horas ya nosotros habíamos hecho planes para ese día y no pudimos hacer muchas cosas

Not bad. UI is a little challenging to find current bookings, until you’ve familiarized yourself, which many tourists won’t do. Performed reliably for the two-day pass we used. Had no trouble with vendors supporting it the same as a ticket.
It’s A Scam!!!. I was charged twice. My mom was charged 5!!! Times! Don’t buy these off of the guys in red jackets in NYC!!!
First time in New York. Life saver i recommend it 100% it did my trip alot easier!

Pass works till 5 pm only and they have not mentioned anywhere. Pass works till 5 pm only where as Madam Tsudards and Chinese theatre and other attractions opens till 8 pm or more. Please be careful before purchasing the pass. I would suggest to buy from a genuine and transparent agency or directly from attractions and not fall with this trap.

Not useful and dumb customer support. We bought san antonio pass and its not very useful, basically you just buy once instead of buying them separately at each attraction, nothing more than that and the support team doesnt even know basics, they just say yes for any wishful question you ask and their job is to make sure you dont cancel the pass after you realize the restrictions it has.
New orleans history and voodoo tour. Erin was very funny and knowledgeable, I appreciated how respectful she was about the voodoo religion
Unclear where to get bus and time schedules. Not good

so worth it and so enjoyable. i did the las vegas go city pass through groupon for my trip, and it was such an amazing experience using the gocity pass, we got to go to 3 different shows where we were treated like VIP’s and given upgrades, as well as had deep discounts for so many fun activities. loved it and would purchase it again, i wish it had more activities in other cities i would like to visit though!
Much much recommended. We recently had a trip to San Diego and got the all inclusive pass. We were going to everywhere like VIP

Disappointed - Limited options meant using only half of what I paid. I am extremely frustrated at the lack of transparency on the all exclusive passes. First of all, they don’t tell you until you buy that many of the included activities only offer access in the early part of the day. This makes it extremely difficult to fit in enough to get your money’s worth. Even after purchasing the pass, you have to dig and dig just to find this information.

Please save yourself the trouble and just pay for things outside of this pass. Once your day is up, that’s it, all that unused money goes down the drain and they don’t give you any refunds or extensions on the unused credits.

I spent over $100 and didn’t even come close to $50 for the two activities I did.

I should have read the reviews before getting one.

Offers not valid. We bought the Go Pass for a trip to Boston to do multiple things. Once we arrived we found out at least two of the attractions that were listed as being part of the package- no longer were accepting of the Pass. The only things we were able to do was the bus tour and the cruise. Check to see if what you are looking at doing are actually accessible prior to purchasing your pass. Do not know if they are not being compensated or what the deal is.
Our bus driver was actually fun and knowledgeable but we could have saved our money and bought individual tickets.

Didn’t get over $100 in ticket credit. Family went to visit The Shard in London on our all-inclusive pass. Followed the prompts through the app, inputting our ticket numbers to get the reservation to the Shard directly as it stated. The Shard charged us the full ~$140 and when I asked Go City about it, they said they couldn’t do anything about it. I explained that I followed their instructions for the all-inclusive items/reservations and they essentially told me too bad. Terrible customer service.
Customer service is prompt and helpful. I called to ask questions and it was not difficult to contact them. The App is also easy to use.

Fraud!. I was trying to make reservations for Legoland. The app accidentally selected todays date as my reservation. I immediately attempted to change the date (within 3 minutes of initially purchasing the pass), but the app would not permit me to change it or get a refund. After waiting AN hour to communicate with anyone, they still would not permit me to change dates. The app should CONFIRM the date before locking it in, especially when they won’t even grant you 3 minutes to change a reservation. This is honestly robbery.
Great experience!. Using the pass was so easy. It was great not having to worry about paying at each location.

Pass issues. Bought a pass for 48 hours at 6pm with intention to use for 48 hours. However, at 10.30am (after 40 hours, when one full day of museums in Stockholm left and planned) in Vasa museum they say we cannot use the pass. It’s only been 40 hours! I planned to see 3-4 museums in that time but museum staff says it’s expired. No way! I paid 1216.00 SEk (€110 or $120) for 1 museum and 1 hop on hop off bus ride? I paid for All inclusive! Scam or bad explanation of what 48 hours look like- if it’s 2 calendar days and 1 day considered 1 workin hour (when we bough at 6pm)- the. It’s a scam!

Not worth it. I purchased this for our trip to Boston. Not worth it. The hop on and off bus has to be activated at the warf. If you are not staying near there, you have to make your way over there first. The freedom trail tour is not one of the high rated ones. The ghost tour company canceled on us last minute. It does not cover the north church or the Boston Tea Party museum. The Harvard tour was good and the crime tour was good. However adding those 2 up does not cover the cost of the pass.

$$ Saving but with Hiccups. So far we have not been able to book any of our activities directly through the app. There have been issues with both Warner Bros & Whale watching such that we had to call and/or email multiple times to get things booked. Trying to book Big Bus tours now through the Go City app and getting error messages. Currently the Explore and Trip planning functions are not working. If the app works, it does save you some money vs paying separately, although the regular price for whale watching of $56 on the site is not accurate, since it's actually only $30, so it may not have been truly cost saving, especially since you have to pay large parking fees everywhere.

Total rip off. Purchased a San Diego Explorer 2-attraction pass thinking we could save a bit of money. Wrong! Even using the Zoo as one attraction (the most expensive thing you can do on that pass), it was still almost impossible to find a second attraction that made the pass worthwhile. Ultimately we paid more for every pass than if we’d just paid for entries per attraction. Absolutely would not recommend unless you get an All-Inclusive pass and want to spend a full 12 hours/day visiting attractions.

Brand New To Go City. I had a not so great experience with my first experience with Go City. I placed an order for passes and all of the confirmation emails were sent to me in a different language and I could not tell what language it was. So I contacted Support via chat and they told me I just needed to translate them and then they stopped responding altogether. I asked them what language it was, and then they just would not respond. So I had to call Go City and when I called them, they said there was no way they could resend me the emails in English and to just translate them. But they did send me a link and I was able to get the app downloaded and synced with my passes. But this took about 45 minutes and I was on hold when I called for about 25 minutes before anyone answered. Furthermore I’ve made some bookings ahead of time and used the links on the website and the app and then the bookings are not syncing into my booked attractions portion of the app and website. I called and the person I talked to said just to use the email confirmations sent by the individual attractions. I’m trying to figure out what good the app is for and why there is a QR code there when we can’t use it but have to find an email in order to gain entry into our booked attractions. It has a trip planning feature but its hard to use and difficult to add items to favorites. All in all I find it very clunky and not user friendly. I hope I don’t have any problems on my trip.
Terrible!. No Big Buses in sight! And NO usable map to find locations and directions. August
Beware!!!. Most of the things on the All Inclusive Pass were either not open or were open limited times and not available when we tried to use them.
Bad service / bad passes. Passes don’t work at San Diego Safari. I called. No one is picking up the phone.

Constant guided trip cancellation. Four out of five booked guided trips were rescheduled to either another date (a month after) or another time slot the day notifying you the day right before the scheduled day, which I booked a month ago. It totally ruined my vacation and plan. The only option is to go with amigo tour. Their service is shady.

Cost more than buying tickets direct! Don’t do it!. I spent more buying thes than had I just bought tickets direct. There were no lines anywhere so it didn’t save me any time either. I still had to convert this to tickets anyway. One of the museums even admitted this is a scam. Talking to them about not working with this company. Grrr.

Uh oh. I wanted to ask a simple question but their “24 hour” line does not appear to be manned. It just blares a continuous message about how to apply for a refund online. Not helpful, as this isn’t what I needed, and leaves me with a sinking feeling as I prepare for the trip, if that’s the only reason why people call. Can’t wait to see if this thing works…

Ripoff. Go City is a waste of time and money. I do not recommend at all. I purchased a 4-pack for myself and my children for a special trip to New York City. The total cost was $400. We were only able to use 2 of 4 passes due to the horrible procedure to exchange this pass for actual tickets. 

If you want to wait in long lines to redeem your Go City pass for an actual ticket and then wait in another long line to see the attractions, then this app is for you.

Buyer Beware. Be wary of purchasing GoCity passes. Purchasing a GoCity pass does not guarantee you entry into the advertised attractions. GoCity website nor app maintain updated information regarding their advertised attractions and reservation requirements. GoCity website, app and confirmation email advertise many attractions as walk up only. GoCity website and app do not permit you to make reservations for attractions that are advertised as walk up only. While GoCity may not require a reservation for an advertise attraction, the attraction itself may actually require a reservation. Before purchasing a GoCity pass, check each attraction website directly for the most updated information on reservations in order to help ensure entry into an advertised attraction. GoCity will not issue a refund once the pass has been activated nor provide any corrective actions for losses incurred due to their deceptive advertising practices.

They could see that it had only been “scanned” at one place. They absolutely refused to help us until they received confirmation from the attraction that we had not been there. However, the attraction is question was a ghost tour that was not open at 9am. We spent a ridiculous amount of our limited vacation time calling, three way calling, and basically pleading for help. We finally got ahold of someone at the tour, after burning a considerable amount of our day, to confirm we had not yet used a pass. By this point, we had missed a different reservation. I think the passes are a great plan, but I was very disappointed in the lack of help.
